ProgramUnit.Name: MODIFY_TOOLBAR_BUTTONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE modify_toolbar_buttons (status varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 /*
 ** set button status according to passed parameter.
 */
 if status = 'applications' then
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_record', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.previous_block', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.next_block', enabled, property_true);

 set_item_property('toolbar.insert', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.enter_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.cancel_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.execute_query', enabled, property_false);
 end if;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_toolbar IS
BEGIN

/*
** this function will be run from initialise windows routine.
** following buttons MUST be enabled all the time.
*/
 set_item_property('toolbar.commit_form', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_block', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_form', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_fld', enabled, property_true);
 -- set_item_property('toolbar.redisplay', enabled, property_true);
 -- set_item_property('toolbar.print_screen', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.list_values', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.show_keys', enabled, property_true);
 -- set_item_property('toolbar.print_report', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.exit_form', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('toolbar.display_error', enabled, property_true);

/*
** following buttons can be enabled / disabled
*/
 set_item_property('toolbar.enter_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.cancel_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.execute_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_record', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.insert', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.previous_block', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.next_block', enabled, property_false);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number; 
begin
 if :ctrl_block_1.appl_id is null then
 show_error('9132');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 select count(*) into :global.x
 from applications
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id;
 
 if :global.x < 1 then
 al_id := Find_Alert('new_appl_alert');
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 :applications.appl_id := :ctrl_block_1.appl_id;
 go_item('applications.appl_name');
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve_info', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.appl_id','D');
 else
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.appl_id');
 show_error('9136');
 check_package_failure;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve_info', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 -- item_change('ctrl_block_1.appl_id','E');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 else
 go_block('applications');
 execute_query;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve_info', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.appl_id','D');
 end if;
end;

DECLARE

BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
